provenance.modifications: 1 real Eagle Point Park entry, South Loop, Central Loop and North Loop paths stitched through the OSM graph, heading Gaussian-smoothed, positions re-integrated from heading, then pinned back onto the real junctions (largest drift closed 0.0 m, spread back along each line), resampled at 1.5 m with curvature from the sampled positions; land elevation from 3DEP low-pass filtered, bridge decks synthesized (3DEP is bare earth); lanes simplified to the configured cross-section; junction connector roads synthesized (a turn, a straight and a turn) Natural terrain uses preserved USGS 20 m grid observations from two acquisitions and simplified OSM river polygons with holes; authored 2^-10 m noding, 0.02 m road overlap, a road collar blended within 40 m with 0.06 m tuck, and median interior-water DEM proxy, not current stage. Exact Float32 geometry and frozen extraction inputs are recorded in tools/gis/terrain/eagle-point/manifest.json.

meta.notes: Open traversals of Eagle Point Park entry, South Loop, Central Loop and the long northern arc, ending before the northern loop rejoins the entry drive. OSM line and actual USGS terrain; main approach two-way, loops forward-only following the city road-map arrows. No pedestrian bridge, short bypass, alternate or repeated-edge lap. Widths are arcade adaptations, not surveyed: entry two 3 m lanes plus 1.5 m shoulders each side; loops one 3 m lane; 0.5 m soft grass verges. The 8.94 m/s traffic pace and paved-shoulder patrol marker are gameplay choices, not surveyed signs or a real parking lot. No claim about current on-site motorcycle access or exact retaining-wall positions. Tower landmark placement uses the approximate center of OpenStreetMap way 839770216 (https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/839770216), retrieved separately on 2026-10-22T20:08:05Z at 41.8941338, -90.1737434; the original highway geometry query did not supply this point. The original model and its terrain foundation are gameplay adaptations, not a surveyed building footprint or dimensions. Natural coverage is bounded, coarse source-derived terrain with an authored road collar; holes and water remain hazardous. No surveyed riding terrain, current water-stage or motorcycle-access claim.
